source: electron-builder's AppImage toolset with the static type2 runtime (electron-userland/electron-builder-binaries, release appimage@1.0.3; runtime from AppImage/type2-runtime release 20251108), selected by "toolsets": {"appimage": "1.0.3"} in desktop/package.json and downloaded by electron-builder 26.18.0
why: libindicator (GPL-3.0) is in usr/lib of the toolsets (legacy and 1.0.x); the licence rule (spec 8.10) forbids GPL in the package. libappindicator cannot load without it and serves only a tray icon, which this app does not have. The legacy toolset's runtime needs libfuse.so.2 on the machine; the 1.0.3 runtime is static (release check 'runtime').
